note: Audit pass 2: orchestrator + pipeline + agent stores (build-orchestrator pipeline settings/accounts, orchestrator.json settings blocks, claude-accounts workers.json, agent-slots, claude-settings, gate / auto-lander, push-banner), with the live documents on the hub volume.
caveats: builds/pipeline/accounts.json holds use / fable / parallel per account: the pipeline's own copy of what claude-accounts workers.json owns (workers, excluded, perAccount.building, limits.building). Duplicate 1.

builds/pipeline/settings.json parallelPerAccount defaults from claude.builds.maxParallel (pipeline.mjs loadSettings) and autoQueue is fed from claude.builds.launchWithoutAsking: two keys each in two stores.
builds/orchestrator.json rules.approveModelSwitch is read by nobody but the UI type; framework/core/model-switch.mjs reads claude.builds.fableUpgradeApproval. Dead copy.
console/auto-lander/state.json policy is the lander's projection of control.json settings, rewritten every tick by the same writer: a derived snapshot, not a second owner.

plugins/gate/lander.json mergeQueue duplicates plugins/push-banner/config.json mergeQueue (gate lander.mjs mode() prefers its own copy); gate rules.json ui-review.enabled is mirrored into push-banner landWaitUi by gate-store mirrorRules.

console/agent-slots/build-limit.json maxBuilds, console/agent-slots/settings.json maxAgents and claude.builds.maxParallel are three 'how many at once' caps; only the first two are enforced (agent-slots), the claude one only seeds parallelPerAccount.
plugins/claude-settings/settings.json is the offline fallback; the live owner is settings/claude/settings.json.
